a|EY.note: Letter-name variant remains unverified; the reduced AH variant is available.

al|AE L.note: Capitalization for the spoken name; lowercase repeatedly produced silence.

bass|B AE S.note: Respelling checked against the phoneme recognizer to avoid the base reading.

bow|B AW.note: Exact homophone for the bending pronunciation.

bow|B OW.note: Exact homophone for the ribbon pronunciation.

dove|D AH V.note: Bird pronunciation checked against the phoneme recognizer.

dove|D OW V.note: Respelling checked for the past-tense long-O pronunciation.

lead|L EH D.note: Exact homophone for the metal pronunciation.

lead|L IY D.note: Long-E verb pronunciation; review before publishing.

live|L IH V.note: Respelling for the verb, matching the supported short-I outline.

ma|M AA.note: Phonetic respelling; lowercase ma repeatedly produced silence.

om|AO M.note: Phonetic respelling for the literal syllable rather than a prolonged chant.

read|R EH D.note: Exact homophone for the supported past-tense outline.

read|R IY D.note: Exact homophone if a long-E outline is supported later.

route|R AW T.note: Exact homophone for the how pronunciation; prevents the root reading.

route|R UW T.note: Exact homophone for the long-U pronunciation.

rim|R IH M.note: Phonetic respelling; rim repeatedly produced silence.

to|T UW.note: Exact homophone for the standalone pronunciation.

to|T IH.note: The rare reduced short-I form did not yield a usable recording.

tear|T EH R.note: Exact homophone for the supported ripping pronunciation.

ugh|AH G.note: Homophone for the literal word instead of a nonverbal grunt.

wind|W AY N D.note: Exact homophone for the winding pronunciation.

wind|W IH N D.note: Short-I air pronunciation; review before publishing.

wound|W AW N D.note: Respelling for past-tense wind; review before publishing.
